verdict.rationale: Marketing Hub ships AI agents, so connecting external MCP servers is a fair question for it, but the pack has no evidence that it can act as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence (hubspot-probe-4) is HubSpot's own official MCP server, which is the server role and does not show HubSpot consuming tools from other MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
